label: Freezing the extension ABI
subgoals: Distinguish the source API from the binary ABI
Identify layout and signature changes that break plug-ins

label: Versioning every change
subgoals: Give each tier of change its own version record
Attach the request, evidence and approver
Name exact versions in each run's provenance

label: Rollback and compatibility
subgoals: Keep old artifacts immutable and available
Map each tier to its rollback action
Refuse plug-ins built for an incompatible ABI
